name: N-ethylheptylone
summary: N-Ethylheptylone (HEP) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted cathinone family, with stimulant effects. It is a homologue of related drugs such as ethylone, eutylone, ephylone and N-ethylhexylone but with a longer pentyl side chain. It was first reported in Sweden in 2019.
